map.44100 是 CD 标准、48000 是视频/专业标准；体积差约 9%（字节率: 44100 is the CD standard and 48000 is the video/professional standard; the size difference is about 9% (bit rate is proportional to sample rate), and mixes are usually unified to 48000 before delivery.
map.MP3 码率越高越好吗？: Is a higher MP3 bitrate always better?

Useful for estimating size and choosing a format before audio processing.
map.导出前按采样率、位深、声道估文件体积，选合适格式: Estimate the file size from sample rate, bit depth and channels before export, and pick a suitable format
map.比较 WAV 无损与 MP3 有损的体积差异做存储/上传决策: Compare the size difference between lossless WAV and lossy MP3 to make storage and upload decisions
map.统一不同素材的采样率避免 DAW 内重采样损耗: Unify the sample rate of different material to avoid resampling loss inside the DAW
map.越高体积越大、越接近无损；192 kbps 已近 CD 听感，320 为最高码率: The higher the bitrate the larger the file and the closer to lossless; 192 kbps is already close to CD quality and 320 is the maximum bitrate. For web distribution 128-192 kbps balances size and quality.
map.采样率 44100 和 48000 差多少？: How much difference is there between sample rates 44100 and 48000?
map.：44100 Hz / 16 bit / 立体声 → 字节率 = 44100 ×: : 44100 Hz / 16 bit / stereo -> byte rate = 44100 x 16/8 x 2 = 176400 B/s = 1411.2 kbps; about 10.09 MB per minute, so a 10-minute WAV is about 100.9 MB.
map.：同一 3 分钟音频：MP3 320 kbps ≈ 320×180/8/1024: : for the same 3-minute audio, MP3 320 kbps is about 320 x 180 / 8 / 1024 ~= 7.03 MB; 192 kbps is about 4.22 MB; 128 kbps is about 2.81 MB (WAV about 30.3 MB).
